title: refactor(spec): codemod split of conversions/registry.ts into per-entry modules (#29987)
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfgvGexKn9vLHsy89K

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBKGNRxbkYw4a3n8552mQyGC)_

Fixes #29987

Ruling-ref: 6583399215
Clause-②: no (move-only)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up filed as #29994 — .claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md (it still says a new conversion is written in `conversions/registry.ts`; after the split it is a module under `conversions/entries/` plus one import line in `registry.ts`)

ADR-0087 / D3: no migration entry moves. `migrations/` is untouched, and `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` exits 0.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：codemod `scripts/codemod-split-conversions-registry.mjs` 把 `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`（16,019 行）拆成 112 个条目模块（`entries/<toMajor>/<id>.ts`）加一个 `entries/shared.ts`；`registry.ts` 剩 354 行，只留导入和四张表。另有 4 个按路径读这个文件的读者同步放宽，build-schemas 的三处 D2 补救提示也改成了拆分后的写法。
- 为什么改：#29465 大文件拆分计划（裁决 6583399215）的一部分，已在今天的窗口里于最新 `main`（`c2d353d2`）上重新生成。这张表是冲突最多的文件之一，按条目拆开后，每条 conversion 单独成文件，评审和合并都更容易。
- 风险与回滚：只搬不改。159 条语句、727,159 字节逐字节相同；`ALL_CONVERSIONS` 和每个 `CONVERSIONS_BY_MAJOR[n]` 的 id、顺序和函数源码在 base 与 head 完全一致；每次 head 构建的 134 个声明文件都与一次同状态的 base 构建逐字节相同（`main` 自己的 d.ts 构建在两种状态间交替，见 Tests）。回滚就是 revert 这个 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`（新的宿主文件）、`entries/shared.ts`，以及下面的读者普查表。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`，然后 `node scripts/codemod-split-conversions-registry.mjs --verify --base origin/main`（字节一致）和 `--arrays --base origin/main`（表相等）。
- 需要你做的：不用做什么。你已批准在今天的窗口落地，CI 在 `dca57060` 上全绿，由 spec 席位送入合并队列。

## What changes

- **New:** `scripts/codemod-split-conversions-registry.mjs`. It sits beside the pilot's `codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs` and follows its conventions (ts-morph in memory, a plan mode, `--write`, `--verify`, `--self-test`).
- **Generated:** `packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/11/` (3), `15/` (2), `17/` (12) and `18/` (95) hold one module per conversion entry, named by its `id`. `entries/shared.ts` holds the 11 helpers that two or more entries read. The 31 helpers that only one entry reads move into that entry's module, following pilot ruling 6591753301. Every module is a leaf: it imports `../../types.js`, `../../walk.js`, `../shared.js` and the spec modules `registry.ts` already imported (for example `ui/assembled-views.zod.js`), and never another entry.
- **Host:** `registry.ts` keeps its module docblock, `import type { MetadataConversion }`, one import line per entry in base definition order, and `OrderedConversion`, `inApplicationOrder`, `MAJOR_18_CONVERSIONS`, `CONVERSIONS_BY_MAJOR` and `ALL_CONVERSIONS` byte for byte, including the `@__PURE__` markers. The public import path `conversions/registry` and its two exports are unchanged.
- **Readers widened** (ruling 6597555122):
  - `packages/spec/scripts/conversions-major18-merge.test.ts` now reads the import lines in `registry.ts` and each `entries/18/` module.
  - `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` reads the conversions ledger as `registry.ts` plus `entries/**`, and gains a CR1-CR3 battery.
  - `scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs` treats `registry.ts` plus `entries/**` as the conversion table.
  - `scripts/adr-anchors/`: the ADR-0120 anchor follows `declared-index-unique-scope` into its module, and the host keeps ADR-0087.
  - The `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs` row note was updated.

## Reader census (all 111 files on base `c2d353d2` that name `conversions/registry`)

| class | files | disposition |
|---|---|---|
| import | 51 | unaffected: both exports stay in `registry.ts` (3 tests `vi.mock` it, same exports) |
| prose only | 47 | unaffected (CHANGELOGs, docblocks, ADR text) |
| code reads the path or text | 13 | one row each below |

| code reader | disposition |
|---|---|
| `packages/spec/scripts/conversions-major18-merge.test.ts` | **widened**. The base version fails 3 of its cases on the split tree; the widened one passes 12/12 |
| `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` | **widened**; self-test 710 assertions pass, `--base origin/main` exit 0 |
| `scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs` | **widened**. The pre-edit version fails 2 counterfactual cases on the split tree; the edited one passes 605/605 |
| `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__spec__src__conversions__registry.ts.json` | **split**: ADR-0120 moved with its entry, so a new anchor was added for `entries/18/declared-index-unique-scope.ts`. `check:adr-anchors` exit 0 |
| `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs` | row note updated (prose of a NOT_DRIVER_MANAGED row) |
| `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas.ts` | **reworded** (`c5fc1136`): its three D2 remedies now name a module under `src/conversions/entries/` plus its import and array line in `src/conversions/registry.ts` |
| `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.deletion-proofs.test.ts` | **pin added** (`c5fc1136`): the remedy names `src/conversions/entries/` with the toMajor directory. It fails on the old remedy text |
| `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.retired-keys.test.ts` | **pin added** (`c5fc1136`): the remedy names `src/conversions/entries/`. It fails on the old remedy text. The two check-mode tests pass 29/29 |

To reproduce the census: `git grep -l 'conversions/registry' c2d353d2 -- scripts packages/spec`. The one file new since the Phase 0 base `5cdaddbc` is `packages/spec/src/system/auth-revoke-sessions-on-password-reset-retirement.test.ts`, and it is an import.

## Tests

Phase 1 readings: head `dca57060` (a plain merge of `main` `c2d353d2` into `c5fc1136`, no rebase), base `c2d353d2`. `main` did not touch `packages/spec/src/conversions/` between `5cdaddbc` and `c2d353d2`. Regenerating from `main`'s `registry.ts` with `--write` leaves `git diff HEAD` empty, so the merge is the regenerate.

- **Byte-identity:** `--verify --base origin/main` (`c2d353d2`) exits 0. It compares 159 statements (727,159 bytes). All 112 of 112 entries and all 42 helpers moved (11 into `entries/shared.ts`), and 5 statements stayed. It writes 113 modules and checks 584 import bindings. Undoing the split rebuilds the base `registry.ts` byte for byte.
- **Tables:** `--arrays --base origin/main` exits 0. Exports match (`ALL_CONVERSIONS`, `CONVERSIONS_BY_MAJOR`). `ALL_CONVERSIONS` holds 112 ids, sha256 `6dfde60307ccd336d6265e84bb095632acbbdbcd08483d73f5e83070c9728ae7`, in the same order. `CONVERSIONS_BY_MAJOR` is `{11: 3, 15: 2, 17: 12, 18: 95}` with the same membership and order. 112 of 112 entry digests are equal, where a digest is JSON with the function source included.
- **Determinism:** two `--write` runs from `main`'s unsplit `registry.ts` (input sha256 `3f5386899b7024a1e429d6a7b93cd41ce567f1171bfb5ee27974d1ffb2ec6c01`) both give output tree sha256 `960cdabf7a6532e0f0ffaa035cbe200a85b0eff2a1ddea58b0df515b4147d74b`, the same as Phase 0, and leave `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Declaration files** (ruling 6348891160 item 1, read with 6441032442 B's second normalisation, S1 applied):
  - **The tree was quiet.** The four builds ran back to back in one locked script, in the order head-1, base-1, head-2, base-2. Nothing else ran in either worktree or on the box, and the tests and gates started only after the builds finished.
  - **The builds:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` produced base-1, head-1, base-2 and head-2. Each build's 134 declaration files fall into one of two states, with set sha256 `cb955a20e1de3c63…` or `cdac5d7b0c33761e…`. base-1 and head-2 are in the first state; head-1 and base-2 are in the second.
  - **The pairing:** base-1 ≡ head-2 and base-2 ≡ head-1. Each pair is 134/134 raw byte-identical. `dtsnorm.mjs` passes on both pairs, and its control (a renamed declaration in `action.zod-CQhac7BH.d.mts`) is caught, with the normalised hash and the surface digest both DIFFER. The codemod's `--dts base-1 head-2` reads PASS, with its control (a dropped `readonly`) caught.
  - **Why the cross pair reads FAIL (9):** `--dts base-2 head-2` reads FAIL (9). The 9 are the 8 files `api`, `contracts`, `marketplace` and `system` `index.d.ts` / `index.d.mts`, plus the renamed `automation-api.zod` chunk pair. base-1 against base-2 differs in exactly the same way: 10 files and 34 statements, with string-literal members in another order inside `z.ZodEnum` record types and object shapes, and the declared-surface digest EQUAL on every file. This is `main`'s own `.d.ts` build being nondeterministic from run to run, not the split. Every quiet head build equals a quiet base build byte for byte, so no reorder belongs to head.
  - **A correction to Phase 0's acceptance note 3:** the irregular head builds reported there were this same nondeterminism. They were not caused by the concurrent gates.
  - The readings are in the project files under `issue-29987/phase1/`.
  - `check:api-surface` and `check:dual-source-exports` exit 0.
- **Self-test:** `--self-test` runs 40 cases in 6 batteries, and all pass.
- **Spec suite at the base's counts:** base `c2d353d2` and head `dca57060` both give `test` 811/811 files and 24,376 tests plus 1 todo, and `test:repo` 90/90 files and 1,539 tests.
- **Built-entry checks:** `pure-schema-construction.test.ts`, including the `./shared` consumer bundle, is in the local suite above and passes.
- **Type-check:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exits 0 at head with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144`. Without the flag, the `check:test-typecheck` step runs out of heap at about 2 GB on this box, at base and at head alike.

## Acceptance notes

1. **Size.** 35,227 changed lines (+19,405 / -15,822 in 124 files against `c2d353d2`) is over the 3,000-line threshold. The maintainer approved landing it in today's window.
2. **`skip-changeset`:** the `.d.ts` meets ruling 6348891160 item 1 in its strongest form, raw identity against a base build of the same state. Following 6441032442 item 4 and the pilot PR #29598, the PR takes no changeset.
3. **Phase 0's irregular head builds.** Phase 0 put them down to concurrent gate runs. That was wrong: Phase 1 shows `main`'s spec `.d.ts` build alternating between two states on a quiet tree (see Tests). A `.d.ts` reading for any spec split therefore has to pair builds of the same state, and a single base-against-head pair can read FAIL with no change at all.
4. **Follow-ups, noted and not filed:**
   - The `MAJOR_18_CONVERSIONS` docblock in the host still says to define a conversion directly above the entry that follows it. It has to stay byte-identical in a move-only PR, so the merge test now gives the post-split spelling: import it directly above that entry's import.
   - The skills line above names the second follow-up (#29994, which also covers this docblock).

## Verification

- Regenerate (in the Phase 1 window, on the latest `main`, never a rebase): `git checkout origin/main -- packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`, then `node scripts/codemod-split-conversions-registry.mjs --write`. `--write` deletes stale codemod-marked modules and refuses any file under `entries/` that it did not write. If the regeneration moves different code, re-check the reader table above.
- Proofs: `node scripts/codemod-split-conversions-registry.mjs --verify --base origin/main`, then `--arrays --base origin/main`.
- `.d.ts`: build `@objectstack/spec` at least twice at base and twice at head on a quiet tree, pair builds of the same state, then run `node scripts/codemod-split-conversions-registry.mjs --dts BASE_DIST HEAD_DIST`. The report reading under 6441032442 B is `dtsnorm.mjs`, kept in the project files at `issue-29987/dtsnorm.mjs`, sha256 `e0b4b0c3d6a29e99dea99b2a65b683b0649f3e7c6d4fa671b994d590d48219b4`. Run it as `node dtsnorm.mjs --typescript node_modules/typescript --dirs BASE_DIST HEAD_DIST --control`, and expect exit 0 and `"pass": true`.
- Gates at head `dca57060`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 96, and all 96 exit 0, including `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:doc-formula-expressions`, which are measurable now. `--ran` exits 0: 96 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 unrun.
- CI at `dca57060`: 54 check runs succeeded and 10 were skipped; none failed.
